verdict.rationale: Superhuman Mail documents automations: Auto Labels, Auto Archive, and agents that run on triggers built via chat or a visual builder. Versioning, change review, and rollback are therefore a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack contains nothing about version history, reviewing changes to automations, or rolling them back. Admin governance over who can build agents, and reviewing drafted emails, are adjacent features that earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
